source_of_truth: Flutter MintickMindScreens.all / MindFixtures.models and strategy catalog, repository dev
provenance: Code-audited requirements only; proposed fields are NOT a claim that commercial data is acquired, model is deployed or backend has records
global_invariants: No fabricated market values or predictions in connected UI
All observed/available/captured/ingested timestamps are independently retained
Any missing mandatory licensed input => UNAVAILABLE / ABSTAIN
Historical universe includes delisted, renamed, suspended and inactive listings as-of decision
20-year DAILY target is per listing since listing date, not 20-year tick-level guarantee
Intraday, orderbook, flows, derivatives, fundamentals, corporate actions and fees are separate typed sources
Training label_available_at must exceed decision_as_of and labels may not be used as inference inputs
All evidence includes dataset/feature/model fingerprints, provenance, licensing policy, corporate-adjustment mode and revision
User broker orders and portfolio records remain isolated from shared market data
Model inference cannot bypass deterministic Java risk gates

security_identity.requirements: Historical alias resolution, delisted instruments, mergers/spin-offs and survivorship-safe universe membership

market_calendar.requirements: Session-exact expected bars and no false gaps on holidays

daily_bars.history: 20-25y from each listing date where licensed/available
daily_bars.requirements: Raw daily bars plus separate split-adjusted/total-return views; no fabricated gaps

intraday_bars.requirements: Exactly closed-bar availability; session breaks, out-of-order and late revisions

live_quotes.requirements: WebSocket and last-verified snapshot; never label closed-market cache as LIVE

index_breadth_vix.requirements: Use India VIX, historical NSE/BSE membership, sector classifications and delisted constituents

market_depth_delivery.requirements: L2 depth and delivery stats are not reconstructible from daily OHLCV

corporate_actions.requirements: Splits, bonuses, dividends, mergers, delistings and point-in-time adjustment factors

fundamental_filings.requirements: Financial statements, releases, restatements and fiscal-calendar changes; do not backdate filings

ownership_governance.requirements: Fundamental quality, promoter pledging and governance checks

news_events.requirements: NLP text is separately licensed; timestamp both original publication and first known availability

flows_fii_dii.requirements: Institutional cash and derivatives flows; never infer actual institutional flow from market OHLCV

macro_fx_rates.requirements: FX, rates, commodities, economic surprises and historical revision-vintage data

derivatives_chain.history: contract lifecycle plus licensed short-window OI/IV
derivatives_chain.requirements: Historical option chains and OI/IV/Greeks unavailable from cash daily candles

derivatives_reference_margin.requirements: Actual contract rolls, specs, eligibility and margin cannot be reconstructed from OHLCV

costs_liquidity.requirements: Realistic India net-of-cost backtest, including time-varying charges

model_features.requirements: Compute once from licensed, point-in-time source snapshots; no accidental zero-imputation of missing required features

model_registry_receipts.requirements: Real prediction receipts and monotonic provenance; synthetic fixture leaderboard does not establish trained deployment

backtest_outcomes.requirements: Research only; preserve train/calibrate/test and prospective cohort

trading_room_strategy.requirements: Per-room configuration separate from canonical historical data

portfolio_ledger.requirements: User-scoped auth and custody; never put account/portfolio secrets in shared data lake

risk_execution_controls.requirements: Deterministic Java authority, separately from research forecasts; PAPER/LIVE toggles must not leak authority

account_preferences.requirements: UI preferences are not historical market training features

operations_health.requirements: Always distinguish UI mock data, unavailable source, stale source and validated evidence
